chunks: They ask you about the Hour, when is its fixed time?

key_terms.السَّاعَةِ: The Hour, referring to the Day of Judgment or a specific time of an event
key_terms.مُرْسَاهَا: Its fixed time or when it becomes established

ai.seo_question: When will the Day of Judgment occur according to the Quran?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah An-Najm addresses the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) regarding the timing of the Day of Judgment (Al-Sa'ah). It highlights the questioners' inquiry into when this major eschatological event will occur and become established. In Shia exegesis, this is often linked to the concept of 'Ismah, where the Prophet conveys the divine answer that knowledge rests solely with Allah, reinforcing the distinction between prophetic revelation and absolute divine omniscience.
